record.summary: Statutory AI plan under Article 18 of the AI Act. The current second plan rests on promoting innovation while mitigating risks and has a pillar on leading AI governance ('Enhance AI Trustworthiness'). It calls for strengthening AISI's capacity for technical evaluation of AI models, traceability, technical controls such as guardrails and crisis-time information sharing, and for feeding evaluation results into rules and guidelines. It also covers continuous review of the AI Act, rules for AI agents in public administration that protect citizens' rights, AI cyber-defence, allocating responsibility for harm from agentic AI and the AISI international network.
record.notes: The first AI Basic Plan was decided by the Cabinet on 23 Dec 2025. The second plan (第Ⅱ期計画), decided by the Cabinet on 14 Jul 2026, replaced it. The AI Strategic Headquarters, headed by the Prime Minister with all Cabinet ministers as members, follows up the plan, sets benchmarks and monitors progress. The plan is to be reviewed and changed as needed and, for the time being, every year (当面は毎年変更を行う); the government's provisional English translation renders this as 'in principle annually'. The plan's subtitle, ～日本ＡＸ、より強く、より豊かに～, is rendered in that translation as 'Japan AI Transformation; A Stronger Nation. Greater Prosperity.'

verification.note: Stored on 11 Oct 2026: the Cabinet Office AI Basic Plan page (Japanese), the Cabinet Office's provisional English translation of the second plan (as of 14 Jul 2026), the English summary of the first plan, and the English Interim Report of the AI Strategic Council and AI Institutional Study Group (4 Feb 2025), a different document. Stored on 14 Oct 2026: the second plan in Japanese (22 pages, 令和８年７月14日 閣議決定). The page and the plan confirm the title, the Cabinet decisions of 23 Dec 2025 and 14 Jul 2026, and the 2025 plan's listing under past plans; the summary is checked against the Japanese text, with the subtitle and the pillar name as the government's translation renders them. The public comment period from 19 Jun 2026, given in the earlier notes, is not shown in a stored file; 'KPIs' in the earlier notes is not in the plan, which speaks of benchmarks (ベンチマーク) and monitoring.

judgment.status_reasoning: The Cabinet Office page shows the second plan decided by the Cabinet on 14 Jul 2026 (令和８年７月14日 閣議決定) as the current plan and lists the 23 Dec 2025 plan under past plans; the stored Japanese plan carries the same decision line. The plan is a policy plan with no legal obligations, and it is to be changed yearly for now, but no newer plan is stored, so 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands on 14 Oct 2026.
